description: This PHP class 'EmployeeAddress' extends 'CombinedDisplayField' and defines display fields related to an employee's address details within the OrangeHRM system. It specifies the DTO class used, the address-related fields to retrieve, and the alias for the entity.

classes.name: EmployeeAddress
classes.description: Defines address-related display fields for reporting within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the DTO class associated with EmployeeAddress display field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of address-related fields to be displayed or retrieved.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the entity alias 'employee' used in queries.
